title: dora_keys.cfr_keyings exclusion is inert: `record` never equals the check-run name `governance / record`
claim: dora_keys.cfr_keyings drops an exclusion key only when it equals the full check-run name (`names - drop`). Since the layout cut-over every governance job reports as `<unit> / <job>`, so cfr_exclusions.json's only key `record` matches nothing: over the window's 271 merges cfr_merge_keyed equals cfr_merge_unexcluded (0.808, delta 0.0), while keying the same list on the job id drops the 3 merges whose only red is `governance / record` (0.797, delta 0.011). The brief's own control -- one job added to the exclusion list moves the rate by exactly that job's count -- fails on the instrument: --exclude record leaves the instrument's rate at 0.808.

evidence.unit: cfr_raw_excl_delta_merge (rate delta the exclusion buys in dora_keys.cfr_keyings); job-keyed delta 0.011 (3 merges)
evidence.machine: box B8 (light seat), Linux 6.18.44 container; network-bound, GitHub-reported durations and counts
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; the number is a count / GitHub-reported duration, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: dev/audit/rounds/round4/D11/dora_keys.py:cfr_keyings (with :load_exclusions and :latest_by_name), driven on the window's live check-run listings
perturbation: `--exclude 'governance / record'` (the full name as a key, in memory): cfr_raw_excl_delta_merge moves 0.0 -> 0.011 (up, by exactly the 3 merges); `--exclude record` leaves it at 0.0 while cfr_job_excl_delta_merge reads 0.011
metric_definition: cfr_raw_excl_delta_merge = dora_keys.cfr_keyings(...)['merge_unexcluded'] - ['merge_keyed'] over the window's 271 first-parent merges, latest run per check-run name at the merge commit
phenomenon_property: An exclusion key removes a check run from the change-failure rate exactly when it equals the job id the run's name carries, whatever `<unit> / ` prefix or ` (<matrix leg>)` suffix the name has
seam_rule: grep -nE 'names - drop|name in names|in excl' dev/audit/rounds/round4/D11/dora_keys.py
proposed_fix_scope: key the exclusion comparison in cfr_keyings on the job id (strip the unit prefix and matrix leg, as governance_cost.bare does) and pin it with a unit-prefixed name; S
